quiet-delay-0.description: Four-slot capture bank; overflow returns to captured side. Captured and returned pieces wait 0 owner turns, excluding arrival turn; initial reserves ready. Drops cannot check. Ordinary checkmate, stalemate and threefold repetition; forced wait only outside check without other legal actions and with cooling reserves.
text: The 4×4 board starts empty; White places a king on rank 1, then Black on rank 4.
On each later turn, move one deployed piece or drop one owned reserve piece on an empty square.
A drop may not give check; a normal move may give check.
Research variant: balance-bench.
Captures transfer to the capturer up to 4 held pieces; overflow returns to the captured side.

Bench options: {"captureDelay":0}. Delays tick after the reserve owner's completed play turns, excluding the capture turn for new arrivals. Forced wait only without legal actions and outside check; it consumes one ply. Initial reserves are ready.
Captured non-kings join the capturer’s reserve if fewer than 4 pieces are held; otherwise return to the captured side’s reserve.
Normal king safety and checkmate apply; stalemate and threefold repetition are draws.

checking-delay-0.description: Four-slot capture bank; overflow returns to captured side. Captured and returned pieces wait 0 owner turns, excluding arrival turn; initial reserves ready. Drops may check and immediately checkmate. Ordinary checkmate, stalemate and threefold repetition; forced wait only outside check without other legal actions and with cooling reserves.
text: The 4×4 board starts empty; White places a king on rank 1, then Black on rank 4.
On each later turn, move one deployed piece or drop one owned reserve piece on an empty square.
A drop may give check, just like a normal move.
Research variant: balance-bench.
Captures transfer to the capturer up to 4 held pieces; overflow returns to the captured side.

Bench options: {"captureDelay":0}. Delays tick after the reserve owner's completed play turns, excluding the capture turn for new arrivals. Forced wait only without legal actions and outside check; it consumes one ply. Initial reserves are ready.
Captured non-kings join the capturer’s reserve if fewer than 4 pieces are held; otherwise return to the captured side’s reserve.
Normal king safety and checkmate apply; stalemate and threefold repetition are draws.

no-drop-mate-delay-0.description: Four-slot capture bank; overflow returns to captured side. Captured and returned pieces wait 0 owner turns, excluding arrival turn; initial reserves ready. Drops may check but may not immediately checkmate; opponent must have a legal reply under this same ruleset. Normal board moves may mate. Ordinary checkmate, stalemate and threefold repetition; forced wait only outside check without other legal actions and with cooling reserves.
text: The 4×4 board starts empty; White places a king on rank 1, then Black on rank 4.
On each later turn, move one deployed piece or drop one owned reserve piece on an empty square.
A drop may give check, just like a normal move.
Research variant: balance-bench.
Captures transfer to the capturer up to 4 held pieces; overflow returns to the captured side.

Bench options: {"captureDelay":0,"noDropMate":true}. Delays tick after the reserve owner's completed play turns, excluding the capture turn for new arrivals. Forced wait only without legal actions and outside check; it consumes one ply. Initial reserves are ready.
Captured non-kings join the capturer’s reserve if fewer than 4 pieces are held; otherwise return to the captured side’s reserve.
A checking drop is forbidden if the checked opponent has no legal reply under this same ruleset; mating board moves remain legal.
Normal king safety and checkmate apply; stalemate and threefold repetition are draws.

learning.behavior: Shallow alpha-beta; seeded random choice among equally scored moves.

steady.behavior: Medium alpha-beta; seeded random choice among equally scored moves.

sharp.behavior: Research Sharp: history-aware alpha-beta and objective-aware evaluation; among equally scored moves, prefers the resulting position seen fewer times, while retaining a draw that avoids a worse score.

notes: Drop-policy-cooldown-v1: factorial comparison of capture/return cooldown 0 or 1 with quiet, checking including drop-mate, or checking without drop-mate. Six recipes, six fresh seeds, 16 starts, 96 games each, Research Sharp depth 4. New objective-search-v2 rules adapter identity; same search/evaluation code as variant-options-v1. No pooling with earlier engines and no automatic adoption.
